identity.title: Archive local Codex transcripts to FastWork and recover disk space

values.goal: Recover local disk capacity safely and make FastWork the mandatory parent for future ADL worktrees.
values.required_outcome: Produce a verified FastWork transcript archive without deletion and enforce /Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees in typed binding.
declared_scope: local Codex transcript storage diagnosis and verified FastWork archive
authority_boundary: no destructive cleanup without separate operator approval
typed v2 lifecycle binaries own binding
Git topology remains issue ownership authority
operator_constraints: all future ADL worktrees live under /Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees
do not prune or relocate existing worktrees
do not expose transcript content or secrets
